status: Code and spec only. No month after replay month 12 has been scored with it; the notebook wiring and the first run come later (the owner deploys).
owner_rules_2026_11_06: score whatever new ISIC images arrive; report drift signals that need no labels (input or embedding drift, prediction mix, confidence); a month with no new images records 'no new data' as an explicit status, never a silent green run; add labelled metrics later, when labels exist
confirmed_proposals_2026_11_06: new images are public ISIC IDs the job has not seen before, kept in a table of seen IDs (no upload date is relied on)
they are scored with the model under the champion alias; each image's license and attribution is recorded
each signal is compared with the validation baseline
the status is one of scored, no_new_data or failed
thresholds_chosen_by: Claude, 2026-11-09, before any such run; listed for the owner to confirm or change before the first one
baseline: the clients' validation split (3,210 images), scored once on CPU with the same bundle, as for the existing OOD baseline: OOD scores, penultimate-layer features, predicted classes and top softmax probabilities

ood.test: two-sample KS on the ensemble OOD score, and PSI over 10 baseline-decile bins (cdm.monitor.drift_test)
ood.why: the rule the replay already used (results/phase3/monthly/spec.json), so months before and after month 12 are judged alike

embedding.test: features projected onto the baseline's top principal components (fitted on the baseline only); per component, a KS test and PSI
embedding.alert: any component with KS p < 0.01 / 5 (Bonferroni) and PSI >= 0.2
embedding.why: input drift that the single OOD score can miss; Bonferroni over 5 components bounds this signal's own false-alarm rate near 0.01 per month

prediction_mix.test: chi-square goodness of fit of the month's predicted classes against the baseline's predicted-class shares (classes expected below 5 images pooled), and the total variation distance
prediction_mix.alert: chi-square p < 0.01 and total variation distance >= 0.1
prediction_mix.why: a shift in what the model says, without labels; the distance floor stops a large month alarming on a small change

confidence.test: two-sample KS on the top softmax probability, and the change in its median
confidence.why: falling confidence is an early label-free sign of trouble; the floor stops small changes alarming

month_alert: any of the four signals alerts. The month-level false-alarm rate can be up to about four times one test's; it is not measured yet (backlog item 15 measures false-alarm rates on staged shifts)
below_min_images: signals reported as counts only; none alerts
no_new_data: written as an explicit row and results file with status no_new_data; the run is green but the status says nothing was scored
labels: not used; labelled metrics are added when labels exist for new images
limits: one image download was tested from Databricks Free Edition (2026-11-07); a month's batch was not
listing every public ISIC ID each month means paging through about 553,000 records; its cost is not measured
min_images_why: the repo's minimum for a reported metric (cdm.eval.MIN_GROUP); below about 100 images PSI over 10 bins is large even with no drift (a review's synthetic check averaged about 0.78 at 30 and 0.10 at 100, not a committed result), so the PSI floors would not mean anything
baseline_note: the baseline is the clients' validation split, as for the replay's OOD baseline (results/phase3/monthly/spec.json); all statistics are fitted on it only, never on a month
prediction_mix_pooling: classes expected below 5 images are pooled; a pooled cell still below 5 joins the smallest other cell; with fewer than two cells there is no chi-square test and the distance alone decides. A class the baseline never predicted is listed in unseen_classes, and then the distance alone decides (merged into another cell it could hide behind a class that vanished)
owner_confirmed: 2026-11-09: the owner accepted the signal tests and thresholds as specced
